Great stays are made up of small moments.

The welcome at reception.The question answered before it needs to be asked.The place nearby they would never have found on their own.

Often, it is the smallest details that make a guest feel genuinely looked after.

Keep reading ↓

You already know what great hospitality feels like.

Your team wants to give every guest their full attention.

They just don’t always have the time.

The same questions are asked throughout the day. Useful details are missed. Recommendations depend on who happens to be behind the desk.

And sometimes, everything you would love a guest to know about your hotel never quite reaches them.

A stay is shaped by what a guest discovers, and what they don’t.

Small gaps can shape the entire stay.

A guest doesn’t know the bar is worth visiting.

They never discover the spa.

They search Google for somewhere to eat.

They spend another evening in the room because they don’t know what is waiting just beyond the hotel.

None of these moments feels particularly significant on its own. Together, they can become the difference between a stay that was fine and one they remember.

Anticipate their questions, before they have to ask.

A Strictons guide puts the things that matter into their hands from the beginning.

01The practical details.

02The hotel experiences worth discovering.

03The places nearby worth leaving the room for.

Not everything.
Just the things you would want them to know.

It isn’t about replacing hospitality. It is about protecting it.

When the simple questions are already taken care of, your team has more time for the moments that actually need a person.

A conversation.A thoughtful recommendation.Recognising a returning guest.Doing something unexpected.

The parts of hospitality that cannot be printed on a page.

Get them out of the room.

Down to the bar. Out to the beach, the vineyard, the gallery, the market, or somewhere they had never planned to visit.

A better guest experience is not necessarily about adding more. Sometimes it is simply about helping guests discover what was already there.

What we want the guest to feel

“They thought of everything.”

Not because every part of their stay was scripted. Because the hotel made it easy to settle in, understand where they were, and start enjoying it.

That feeling of being considered is what stays with them.

The stay continues, even when the desk is busy.

Look after every guest, even when you can’t be there.

We design custom hotel guides around the experience you want your guests to have. They receive the answers, recommendations and little prompts that help turn a stay into something worth remembering.
